entry.name: lotame-logout
entry.description: [Obsolete] Lotame provides data connectivity solutions that enable addressability, performance improvement, and consumer choice compliance across the open web and beyond. Their Audience Management solution allows publishers, agencies, marketers, and platforms to connect, enrich, analyze, and activate first-party audiences across all devices and platforms. With their identity platform, Lotame helps extract maximum value from data to build a comprehensive and privacy-safe understanding of consumers across screens. Users can onboard and centralize data, enrich it with machine learning and predictive modeling, analyze consumer behavior, and activate targeted campaigns without relying on third-party cookies. The platform also integrates with various omnichannel partners for syndication purposes. This App-ID covers the traffic for lotame-logout application.
